P1.what: event phase x reason x familiarity: no never-performed configuration enters TAPER/RACE_WEEK/POST_EVENT through a reason-based substitution; the set-aside one never returns; stand-ins are performed, admissible and in the reason's direction; the substitute starts after the event with establishment; the decision discloses it

P2.what: novice x weekly review x reconstructed state: after a decision that rebuilds the capped templates, every later weekly review plans capped weeks exactly when the state is capped, from templates that keep the decision (no set-aside exercise, only available equipment), and history agrees with the plan

P3.what: correction x ASK x block choice: whatever else a review asks, a correction it records comes with the factual re-plan the same correction gives alone; a review that records nothing proposes nothing; the follow-up review never brings the retracted plan back

P4.what: skill mismatch x equipment loss x ladder: once a SKILL_MISMATCH substitute loses its equipment, the replaced exercise's slots never take a configuration above the substitute's skill or above the set-aside one on its ladder; without a lower option the decision asks

RES.what: QE-R7B-01: every applied substitution prescribes its selection in the replaced exercise's slot (N5 grid); QE-R7B-05: a cap started by a context change holds through the next reviews, and with an elapsed week reviewed even when nothing is reported (R18)

r18PathWeekUnreviewed.note: QE-R7B-R2-05: only when an elapsed week receives no review at all (R18 condition, request §9)
